## Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? Is it related to a frustration or a missing capability?

## Proposed Solution
Describe what you want to happen. Keep it outcome-focused — implementation details can be discussed after acceptance.

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or features you've considered.

## Which Area?
- [ ] Frontend (UI/UX)
- [ ] Backend (API/services)
- [ ] AI pipeline (analysis / RAG / comparison)
- [ ] Deployment / DevEx
- [ ] Documentation

## Additional Context
Mockups, links, or references. Check the [roadmap](../README.md#-roadmap) first — your idea may already be planned.
